behavior: Active foliage-gleaner; hops along slender branches, picking insects from leaves, briefly hovering or making short aerial sallies. Singing males often use exposed high perches.
field_marks: Bright yellow head and underparts; adult males show fine chestnut breast streaks
Plain yellow face emphasizing a large, dark eye
Yellow-green back and darker olive wings with yellow-edged feathers
Medium-length, slightly notched tail with yellow inner patches
Small, evenly proportioned body with a rounded head and slender pinkish-brown legs
habitat: Shrubby thickets, open woodland edges, streamside vegetation, and wetland margins; outside the breeding season also uses semi-open woodland, scrub, mangroves, gardens, and other secondary growth.
